parts.t: Burke Mountain is Coquitlam's most exciting new community — a master-planned neighbourhood of modern single-family homes, townhomes, and condos built into a spectacular mountain setting. With kilometres of trails at your doorstep and brand-new schools and amenities being added regularly, it's the top destination for families seeking a fresh start.
